name: 07003 · Bloomfield, NJ
findings: ZIP 07003 (Bloomfield) has 182 nonprofit organizations. 85 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07003 (Bloomfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 15 would.

observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
